values.note: Bring the reservation confirmation and post it on the fee envelope at the campground.

booking.source: recreation.gov facility 270967 (19 of 25 catalogued sites Site-Specific reservable; notice 'This campground has first-come, first-served sites'; 'Must bring confirmation to campground. note: On NH-112 about 4 miles west of Lost River near Kinsman Notch, 9 miles from North Woodstock (I-93 exit 32), in woods on two loops. A CCC-built picnic pavilion and day-use area sit across the highway on the Wild Ammonoosuc River, with views of Mt. Moosilauke. --Claude
summary: FS page + site map + rec.gov 270967: a recreation.gov listing exists (the stored 'not reservable / always first-come' is wrong) - 19 of 25 catalogued sites reservable, the rest first-come. 26 sites, 14 RV spurs take 25-50 ft; $24 incl. one vehicle, +$6 each extra, two on site; vault toilets and water, no showers or dump; mid-May to mid-October. Not waterfront (river across the highway).
